test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 8 Mar 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: "Rail Sahyog web portal" launched by Indian railway is meant for:

options.text: Provide basic amenities i.e. toilet, dustbin etc.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Provide basic amenities i.e. toilet, dustbin etc.**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The "Rail Sahyog" web portal was launched by the Indian Railways to provide a platform for the corporates and PSUs to contribute towards the creation and maintenance of passenger amenities at railway stations.
 
• It focuses on providing basic amenities like toilets, dustbins, benches, and water kiosks at railway stations across India.
 
• The portal aims to enhance the passenger experience by improving the infrastructure and cleanliness at railway stations.
 
• It allows corporate entities to undertake CSR (Corporate Social Responsibility) activities in collaboration with Indian Railways for the betterment of railway infrastructure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Grievance Redressal**

 
 
• Grievance redressal mechanisms are used to address complaints and grievances from the public regarding services provided by an organization.
 
• Indian Railways has separate portals and helplines like the 'RailMadad' app for addressing grievances and complaints.
 
 
 
• **Ticket Reservation**
 
 
• Ticket reservation systems allow passengers to book tickets for train journeys in advance.
 
• Indian Railways uses platforms like IRCTC (Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation) for ticket booking and reservation services.
 
 
 
• **Real-time Train Running Status**
 
 
• Real-time train running status provides live updates on the current location and expected arrival/departure times of trains.
 
• Platforms like 'NTES' (National Train Enquiry System) and various mobile applications offer real-time train tracking services.
